newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - Dec 31.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - Dec 31.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following stories on its front page on December 31:

WASHINGTON - House Speaker Newt Gingrich will seek re-election to his leadership post next week even if the ethics committee has not decided by then on punishment for his violation of House ethics rules.
WASHINGTON - North Korea agreed to join South Korea and the United States in preliminary discussions about negotiations for a formal end to the Korean War.
ACCRA, Ghana - As a great wave of trade and foreign investment transforms the global economy, sub-Saharan countries have been left behind.
WASHINGTON - The Clinton Administration said it will send out letters warning of possible sanctions against doctors, federal contractors and others who invoke new state medical marijuana laws.
WASHINGTON - The District's population still is shrinking sharply, according to new Census Bureau figures that show the city lost 11,000 people in the past year and now has 543,000 residents.
LONDON - Paul McCartney, the former Beatle, will become Sir Paul McCartney, knighted in the New Year honors list.
